title: HUGE private mansion “desert cabin.” Resort yard
description: Newly renovated rustic log home in the heart of gilbert-unique, HUGE 6,000+ sqft house ideal for multiple families. 8 bedrooms/4 full baths. Huge kitchen, kitchenette, double laundry & multiple oversized gathering areas, pool, hot tub, sports court-basketball & pickle-ball, gym. Private & fully fenced. No neighbors-house sits alone, borders canal & paved jog pathways. Close to downtown Gilbert. Sleeps 25-30 ppl in beds/couches. Enjoy staying at this unique, “Cabin in the desert!”
amenities: Exercise equipment: elliptical, free weights, stationary bike, yoga mat
HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Netflix, standard cable, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, premium cable
Private outdoor pool - open specific hours, heated
